ept01-door-power-transfer-devices.title: STAHLOCK MODEL: EPT01 - Hardware Accessories
features: EPT Power Transfer Unit
Concealed, tamper-resistant design for flexible power and data transmission

The EPT Power Transfer Unit provides a secure and continuous power and signal passage between the door frame and the door leaf, delivering stable connectivity for electric locks, panic exit devices, access control systems, and more.

Constructed with a durable stamped steel housing and flexible steel conduit, the unit offers strong protection against bending, wear, and vandalism—ideal for high-traffic commercial and public building applications.
• Mounts on the edge of the door and frame with concealed wiring
• Flexible steel conduit protects cable bundles up to Ø5/16” (8mm)
• Compatible with most hinge types: butt hinges, continuous hinges, and partial pivot hinges
• Rounded mounting tabs for improved installation adaptability
• EPT Standard: Suitable for standard hinges and pivot hinges with <3/4” (19mm) offset
